pro_curriculum.title: Professional Curriculum Builder
pro_curriculum.subtitle: Build a source-grounded study plan using your real textbooks and AI — in 3 steps.
pro_curriculum.step1_subtitle: Run the interactive prompt below in any AI to extract your precise syllabus requirements.
pro_curriculum.step2_subtitle: Supply PDFs, lecture slides, or chapter outlines to anchor the AI's generation.
pro_curriculum.step3_subtitle: Paste the final structured JSON from the AI to instantly populate your LifePivot roadmap.
pro_curriculum.step1_tip: Paste the prompt into any AI assistant. Answer all questions one by one until you receive the Master Prompt at the end.
pro_curriculum.step2_tip: Continue in the same AI session from Step 1. The AI already knows your learner profile.
pro_curriculum.step3_inst2: Open the notebook you created in Step 2 (with your uploaded source files)
pro_curriculum.step3_inst3: Go to the chat input area and paste the Master Prompt from the end of your Step 1 session
pro_curriculum.step3_inst4: Send it — Gemini Notebook will read your sources and output a complete JSON plan
pro_curriculum.step3_inst5: Copy the JSON output, then use the Import Plan button below to create your plan in LifePivot
pro_curriculum.step3_note: If you have no personal textbooks, Gemini Notebook will use the uploaded sources to structure your curriculum — but your tasks will describe what to practice and understand, not what pages to read. The books shape the plan quality invisibly.
pro_curriculum.feature1: Every task grounded in your real textbooks
pro_curriculum.feature2: P0–P5 priorities for the Pivot Engine to manage
pro_curriculum.feature3: Automatic recovery if you miss sessions
pro_curriculum.feature4: XP and gamification on every task
